description: This file defines the OAuthSubscriber class, which implements event handling for OAuth2 token validation and user authentication within the OrangeHRM platform. It subscribes to kernel request and response events to process OAuth tokens, validate them, and manage user authentication state. The class also handles exceptions related to OAuth token processing and response formatting.

classes.name: OAuthSubscriber
classes.description: Handles OAuth-related request validation, user authentication, and exception handling in the OrangeHRM platform by subscribing to kernel request and response events.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events that this subscriber listens to, specifically request and response events.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of AuthenticationService for managing user authentication.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests; checks for OAuth tokens, validates them, and authenticates the user if a valid token is present.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during OAuth token validation, returning JSON error responses if appropriate or throwing session expiration exceptions.

methods.name: onResponseEvent
methods.description: Handles outgoing HTTP responses; invalidates the session if OAuth authentication was used.
